descriptions.rgb: The scene is an open dirt brickyard where the standing camera wearer looks downward and forward toward rows of laid-out bricks on the right, two mounds of wet clay on the left, and a squatting person in a blue shirt. Across the five frames, the camera wearer walks forward and turns slightly right, moving past the first clay mound (which exits the bottom-left of the view by frame 3) and approaching the squatting person until standing directly above and behind them within 0.5 to 1 metre in frame 5, with the camera wearer's own lower legs partially visible at the bottom edge. Throughout the sequence, the squatting person remains beside the second clay mound and the edge of the brick grid, facing downward toward the ground and the clay rather than looking at the camera wearer, while rotating their body from facing roughly toward the camera wearer in frames 1 to 3 to facing away and toward the clay mound in frames 4 and 5. A rectangular brick mold, the second clay mound, and the nearest laid-out bricks are within arm's reach of the squatting person in all frames, and by frame 5 the squatting person's head and shoulders, the brick mold, the adjacent bricks, and the second clay mound all come within arm's reach of the camera wearer. The second clay mound partially occludes the squatting person's lower legs in the first two frames before the camera wearer's elevated, close-up viewpoint in frames 4 and 5 reveals the person from above while cutting off the distant wheelbarrow, hoe, and upper brick rows outside the frame.
